retrieved_via: web text rendering; manually transcribed selected zero-based source rows; generated normalized facts
immutable_content_note: Immutable raw content was unavailable; retrieved master rows are not asserted byte-identical to the history-head revision.
limitations: Counter catalog membership retains COUNTER and its complete damage, direct-harm or mana effect; none is a plain zero-defense armor.
Multipliers use positive raw incoming residual after ordinary defense, not actual HP loss or Dark execution damage.
ID187 applies one 75-percent attempt per alive enemy, not repeated hits on one selected target.
IDs191/192 directly apply Glory/Dark Cloud without HP damage, regardless of hasDamaged at resolution; the Dark attribute of ID192 does not imply execution damage.
ID193 targets its counter owner and increases that source player MP by twice the residual, capped at 99, without charging MP or retaining a miracle.
Multiple unlike counters require explicit queue ordering; an unordered mask cannot preserve all meaningful results.
Old server counter-defense acceptance is retained as source behavior; discrepancy from bot intent remains unresolved C05.
Records188 FOG,189 ILLUSION,194 ABSORB_YEN are completely excluded, with no unsupported effects removed.
Historical IDs and technical labels are not verified current official IDs or names.
Old acquisition weights are not verified official probabilities; upstream reports distribution uncertainty.
All thirteen earlier catalogs, including the separate ID190 Stone counter, fingerprints and miracle indices remain unchanged.
percentage_enqueue: ID187 enumerates currently alive enemies when enqueued; a duel whose only enemy is already dead produces zero queue entries.
percentage_pop: At pop the historical hit test occurs before checking whether the queued target has since died. Dark Cloud skips the random roll and forces a hit.
neutral_attribute: ID193 empty attribute is preserved as the empty string by Item.fromData and participates as neutral in defense attribute composition, distinct from the unselected None sentinel.
